name: @caisson/service-license
description: Merchant-of-Record billing webhook + idempotent credit grants + account-entitlement store/resolver + the Ed25519 offline-license ISSUER HTTP surface (P6, ADR-0089/0017/0071/0108). A gated invoice.paid grants cycle credits AND the plan's entitlements; resolveAccountEntitlements expands stored purchased ids to member slugs against the registry index; the lazy bearer-gated POST /issue signs an account's resolved entitlements into a license token via @caisson/license-issue.
